column2: FARM BUILDING. A structure utilized to store farm implements, hay, feed, grain, or other agricultural or horticultural products or to house poultry, livestock, or other farm animals. Such structure shall not include habitable or occupiable spaces, spaces in which agricultural products are processed, treated, or packaged; nor shall an agricultural building be a place of occupancy by the general public.

HISTORIC STRUCTURE shall be subject to the requirements of these regulations if the proposed work is determined to be a substantial improvement, unless a determination is made that the proposed work will not preclude the structure’s continued designation as an historic structure. The Code Administrator may require documentation of a structure’s continued eligibility and designation as an historic structure.
